description: Justified Bayesian hyperparameter search spaces for PathSnap candidate-classification models (Issue #6, Report §4).
objective_metric: 5-Fold GroupKFold Composite Score: 0.50 * Top-1 Accuracy + 0.35 * Macro F1 + 0.15 / (1 + Log Loss)
objective_justification: Optimizes pointwise route-matching accuracy (Top-1) and class-balanced discrimination (Macro F1) while penalizing poorly calibrated probabilities (Log Loss) that would distort downstream HMM emission log-probabilities.

C.justification: Controls inverse L2 regularization strength across 5 orders of magnitude to balance bias on collinear distance features vs. variance across trips.

class_weight.justification: Tests whether inverse-frequency class weighting improves Macro F1 without hurting probability calibration (Log Loss) compared to unweighted MLE.

tol.justification: Controls L-BFGS convergence tolerance affecting probability precision and training speed.

n_estimators.justification: Controls ensemble size: more trees smooth leaf probability estimates for HMM emissions at the cost of linear inference time.

max_depth.justification: Limits tree interaction depth to prevent memorizing trip-specific road geometries.

min_samples_leaf.justification: Ensures each leaf contains enough observations for smooth Laplace-like probability estimates.

max_features.justification: Controls feature subspace randomness per split to decorrelate trees.

class_weight.justification: Balances 1:K candidate class skew vs. raw posterior probability calibration.

hidden_layer_1.justification: First hidden layer capacity for nonlinear spatial-angular feature representations.

hidden_layer_2.justification: Second hidden layer bottleneck compressing features before logistic output.

alpha.justification: L2 weight decay regularization preventing overconfident probability saturation.

learning_rate_init.justification: Initial Adam step size governing convergence speed and local minimum quality.

n_neighbors.justification: Controls neighborhood smoothing size; larger k reduces zero-probability clipping in Log Loss.

weights.justification: Compares inverse-distance weighting against uniform neighbor voting.

p.justification: Compares Manhattan (L1, p=1) vs. Euclidean (L2, p=2) distance over standardized features.

criterion.justification: Compares Gini impurity against information gain / log-loss splitting criteria.

max_depth.justification: Controls tree complexity to balance underfitting and trip memorization.

min_samples_leaf.justification: Prevents pure 0/1 small leaves that cause extreme Log Loss penalties.

class_weight.justification: Tests balanced vs. natural class priors in leaf probability estimation.
